64678-the-first-man-on-the-moon.title: The First Man On The Moon
64678-the-first-man-on-the-moon.creator: Unknown
64678-the-first-man-on-the-moon.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The transmitter in the rocket had survived the crash. The word would come, thought Thurmon ... when he was ready to send it. And sending it, he would place the official seal of immortality on his brow. The book would close. But wonderfully, satisfyingly. There would be no other to steal his rightful glory. Only Wayne could have done that ... He laughed weirdly within his helmet.

arxiv-1709-09450.title: A Literature Based Approach to Define the Scope of Biomedical Ontologies: A Case Study on a Rehabilitation Therapy Ontology
arxiv-1709-09450.creator: Mohammad K. Halawani 1 , 3, Rob Forsyth 2 and Phillip Lord 1
arxiv-1709-09450.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Mohammad K. Halawani 1 , 3, Rob Forsyth 2 and Phillip Lord 1. In this article, we investigate our early attempts at building an ontology describing rehabilitation therapies following brain injury. These therapies are wide-ranging, involving interventions of many different kinds. As a result, these therapies are hard to describe. As well as restricting actual practice, this is also a major impediment to evidence-based medicine as it is hard to meaningfully compare two treatment plans.

arxiv-2101-09130.title: Bridging the gap between collisional and collisionless shock waves
arxiv-2101-09130.creator: Antoine Bret 1,2, and Asaf Pe’er 3
arxiv-2101-09130.description: Abstract While the front of a fluid shock is a few mean-free-paths thick, the front of a collisionless shock can be orders of magnitude thinner. By bridging between a collisional and a collisionless formalism, we assess the transition between these two regimes. We consider non-relativistic, un-magnetized, planar shocks in electron/ion plasmas.

arxiv-2107-06340.title: EC 22536 − - 5304: A lead-rich and metal-poor long-period binary
arxiv-2107-06340.creator: M. Dorsch, C. S. Jeffery, A. Irrgang, V. Woolf, U. Heber
arxiv-2107-06340.description: Abstract Helium-burning hot subdwarf stars of spectral types O and B (sdO/B) are thought to be produced through various types of binary interactions. The helium-rich hot subdwarf star EC 22536 − - 5304 was recently found to be extremely enriched in lead.

arxiv-2205-11020.title: Artificial intelligence for topic modelling in Hindu philosophy: mapping themes between the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita
arxiv-2205-11020.creator: Rohitash Chandra
arxiv-2205-11020.description: Abstract Abstract A distinct feature of Hindu religious and philosophical text is that they come from a library of texts rather than single source. The Upanishads is known as one of the oldest philosophical texts in the world that forms the foundation of Hindu philosophy.

arxiv-2210-08143.title: The Simplicity of Physical Laws
arxiv-2210-08143.creator: Eddy Keming Chen
arxiv-2210-08143.description: Abstract Physical laws are strikingly simple, yet there is no a priori reason for them to be so. I propose that nomic realists—Humeans and non-Humeans—should recognize simplicity as a fundamental epistemic guide for discovering and evaluating candidate physical laws. This proposal helps resolve several longstanding problems of nomic realism and simplicity.

arxiv-2405-19516.title: Enabling Visual Recognition at Radio Frequency
arxiv-2405-19516.creator: Haowen Lai, Gaoxiang Luo, Yifei Liu, Mingmin Zhao
arxiv-2405-19516.description: Abstract . This paper introduces PanoRadar, a novel RF imaging system that brings RF resolution close to that of LiDAR, while providing resilience against conditions challenging for optical signals. Our LiDAR-comparable 3D imaging results enable, for the first time, a variety of visual recognition tasks at radio frequency, including surface normal estimation, semantic segmentation, and object detection.

arxiv-2408-04487.title: Protons accumulate at the graphene-water interface
arxiv-2408-04487.creator: Xavier R. Advincula, Kara D. Fong, Angelos Michaelides, Christoph Schran
arxiv-2408-04487.description: Abstract Water’s ability to autoionize into hydroxide and hydronium ions profoundly influences surface properties, rendering interfaces either basic or acidic. While it is well-established that protons show an affinity to the air-water interface , a critical knowledge gap exists in technologically relevant surfaces like the graphene-water interface.

arxiv-2509-13898.creator: Keith Ball, Károly J. Böröczky, Assaf Naor
arxiv-2509-13898.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Keith Ball, Károly J. Böröczky, Assaf Naor. For all n , ϕ ∈ ℕ n,\upphi\in\mathbb{N} with ϕ ⩾ n + 1 \upphi\geqslant n+1 , the smallest possible isoperimetric quotient of an n n -dimensional convex polytope that has ϕ \upphi facets is shown to be bounded from above and from below by positive universal constant multiples of max ⁡ { n / 1 + log ⁡ ( ϕ / n ) , n } \max\big\{n/\sqrt{1+\log(\upphi/n)},\sqrt{n}\big\} .

arxiv-2511-06125.title: Evaluation of retrieval-based QA on QUEST-LOFT
arxiv-2511-06125.creator: Nathan Scales, Nathanael Schärli, Olivier Bousquet
arxiv-2511-06125.description: Abstract Despite the popularity of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) as a solution for grounded QA in both academia and industry, current RAG methods struggle with questions where the necessary information is distributed across many documents or where retrieval needs to be combined with complex reasoning.

arxiv-2602-22670.title: Robust Distributed Nonconvex Optimization Enabling Communication Acceleration and Privacy Protection
arxiv-2602-22670.creator: Zichong Ou, Jie Lu
arxiv-2602-22670.description: Abstract This paper addresses a distributed nonconvex optimization problem over multi-agent networks, where each agent exchanges its local information solely with its neighbors. Given that most existing distributed nonconvex optimization algorithms are susceptible to information leakage during inter-agent communications, we propose a Robust Proximal Primal-dual algorithm, referred to as RPP, to enhance the security of information transmission.

pmc-11273198.description: Introduction:Functional neuroimaging has developed a fundamental ground for understanding the physical basis of the brain. Recent studies have extracted invaluable information from the underlying substrate of the brain. However, cognitive deficiency has insufficiently been assessed by researchers in multiple sclerosis (MS).

pmc-11316747.title: Tectonic structures of the Dome Fuji region, East Antarctica, based on new magnetic data
pmc-11316747.creator: Alexandra Guy, Graeme Eagles, Olaf Eisen
pmc-11316747.description: The Oldest Ice Reconnaissance (OIR) airborne geophysical survey in East Antarctica was flown over approximately 170,000 km2 of the Dome Fuji region in 2016/17. The survey’s results support new insights into the subglacial geology and its meaning for the tectonic histories of the supercontinents Rodinia and Gondwana.

pmc-11337588.title: Nociceptive transient receptor potential ankyrin 1 (TRPA1) in sensory neurons are targets of the antifungal drug econazole
pmc-11337588.creator: Kaoru Kasuya, Kenji Takahashi, Miho Hashimoto, Toshio Ohta
pmc-11337588.description: BackgroundEconazole is a widely used imidazole derivative antifungal for treating skin infections. The molecular targets for its frequent adverse effects of skin irritation symptoms, such as pruritus, burning sensation, and pain, have not been clarified. Transient receptor potential (TRP) channels, non-selective cation channels, are mainly expressed in peripheral sensory neurons and serve as sensors for various irritants.

pmc-11600794.title: Unveiling the experiences of operation room nurses on ethical issues: a phenomenological study in Adama Hospital Medical College, Ethiopia, 2022
pmc-11600794.creator: Yohannes Midekso Beriso, Wudma Alemu, Tefera Mulugeta
pmc-11600794.description: BackgroundOperating room nurses are critical in upholding high ethical standards in fast-paced and high-stakes environment to guarantee the safety and well-being of patients undergoing surgery to resolve life-threatening situations. A deeper understanding of ethical issues in the Operating Room helps tailor interventions and policies to address real-world challenges, enhance patient care, and assist healthcare professionals.

pmc-11639376.title: Exploring linguistic features and user engagement in Chinese online mental health counseling
pmc-11639376.creator: Liyuan Zhang, Dexi Liu, Jing Li, Changxuan Wan, Xiping Liu
pmc-11639376.description: With the popularity of online mental health platforms, more individuals are seeking help and receiving social support by openly discussing their problems. Therefore, it's crucial to gain a deeper understanding of which problem disclosures and social support on these platforms can attract more user attention and engagement. Previous research has primarily focused on social media forums.

pmc-12578122.title: Surgical Technique: Management of a Pathological Fracture in the Femoral Neck: Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12578122.creator: Ali Hashem, Zaid AlShammari, Ahmed Altuwaim, Nouf A. Altwaijri
pmc-12578122.description: The unicameral bone cyst (UBC) is a benign lesion that affects children and adolescents between 4 and 14 years of age. They are defined by an osteolytic cavity filled with serous fluid, enclosed by a thin fibrous membrane. Moreover, they are closely associated with skeletal growth and biomechanical stresses during development.

pmc-13186896.title: From Clogging Mitigation to Clogging Acceleration: Particle Deposition Under Oscillatory Flow in Microfluidic Porous Media
pmc-13186896.creator: Walid Okaybi, Sophie Roman, Cyprien Soulaine
pmc-13186896.description: Particle deposition and clogging in porous media control the performance of many natural and engineered applications, including groundwater filtration, geothermal injection, and subsurface fluid management. Once deposits form, permeability progressively declines and flow pathways become blocked, making mitigation strategies essential for maintaining long-term operation.

pmc-13243591.title: Association of single nucleotide polymorphisms in FILIP1-SENP6 and FTO with temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis: clinical and in silico study
pmc-13243591.creator: Emi Ono, Ryota Takaoka, Kotaro Kuyama, Masayuki Ono, You Ueda, Shion Morika, Rie Yamamoto, Hirofumi Yatani, Shoichi Ishigaki, Takafumi Kato, Yuka Uchiyama, Hiroaki Shimamoto, Masahiro Nishimura
pmc-13243591.description: This study investigated the association between temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis and specific single-nucleotide polymorphisms. We also explored the potential functional impacts of these polymorphisms using in silico methods. 354 patients with temporomandibular disorders were classified into osteoarthritis and without osteoarthritis according to the presence of degenerative bone changes in the magnetic resonance imaging including osteophytes, erosion, subchondral cysts, and atrophy.

pmc-13342159.creator: Nathan Thomas Han, Michael B. Steinborn, Liyu Cao
pmc-13342159.description: The complication clock, originally introduced by Wilhelm Wundt, remains a pivotal method in experimental psychology for probing the subjective timing of events. By localising the position of a moving pointer, one can objectively measure when someone perceives an event to have occurred.
